items.prompt: Why compare index multisets/results before timings?

options.text: Unequal work is always the fairer benchmark
A fast wrong answer is a valid substitute
One equal sum proves every future workload is safe
A faster result must compute the intended same contract
options.why: Equal work/meaning is a prerequisite for useful comparison.

items.explanation: Performance claims are meaningful only after the compared computations meet the same intended contract.
